description: This file defines a custom exception class `PasswordTooWeakException` used in the account exception package of the Book Project. It extends RuntimeException and is likely thrown when a user sets a weak password.

classes.name: PasswordTooWeakException
classes.description: A custom exception class indicating that a provided password is too weak.

methods.name: PasswordTooWeakException
methods.description: Constructor that accepts a message string describing the exception.
